Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company, each d/b/a National Grid

Massachusetts Electric Company and Nantucket Electric Company, each d/b/a National Grid (together, the “Company”), submit the following: (1) the standard complete billing percentages (“SCBPs”) for each Customer Class to be effective May 1, 2023 and (2) the status of the reconciliation of the net over-recovery balance incurred through December 2021 that was approved for recovery from competitive suppliers from May 1, 2022 through April 30, 2023. By Maebh Purcell. DPU 23-POR-01
